source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 17546; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. notes: Captured for the development-option families of session 2026-10-15a (M3-T010; D-094 R102; docs/zoning-law-library/options-sections.md). The capture holds the official source text of ZR 25-24 'Special Provisions for Certain Areas' (Last Amended 12/5/2024) and its provenance; it encodes no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, and no derived number.

Both official channels: canonical HTML (node 17546, HTTP 200, sha256/response_bytes pinned) and the print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/17546, HTTP 200). The print/PDF is regenerated per request, so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked.

Section 25-24 is a heading/container only: the official page shows the section number, title and Last Amended stamp, but the page's div.sec-body is EMPTY (no operative body of its own). Its print/PDF (node 17546) renders the heading then its subsections (25-241); those subsections carry the provisions. In this batch 25-241 is captured as its own file; the other siblings are listed in the producer report for a later capture.

Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).
